headline: Major YouTube creators are facing backlash for accepting AI money
summary: Prominent YouTubers Matti Haapoja and Sam Kolder are showcasing AI platform Higgsfield. Their videos promote Higgsfield's Seedance 2.5 for future video production. These creators are now facing significant backlash for accepting AI sponsorships.

headline: Blue Eye Samurai’s second season will hit Netflix in January
summary: Netflix announced the second season of "Blue Eye Samurai" will debut in January 2027. A new trailer and release timeline have been shared for the animated series. The show has also been renewed for a third and final season.

headline: Tesla sunsets its Solar Roof tiles
summary: Tesla has officially discontinued its Solar Roof tiles, Electrek reports. Installers were informed that orders are no longer being accepted for the aesthetic solar product. Tesla will now only supply conventional solar panels for new installations.

headline: My cats hate each other, but this automatic feeder is helping
summary: An owner describes the challenge of feeding two feuding cats multiple times daily. The arrival of a child made the complex feeding ritual unsustainable. An automatic feeder has provided a much-needed solution for their chaotic cat dynamics.

headline: Avengers: Endgame Encore Runtime Revealed, Seemingly Contains Just 4 Minutes of Extra Footage
summary: "Avengers: Endgame Encore" will be released. The extended version adds only four minutes of extra footage. This is Marvel's climactic Infinity Saga finale.

headline: Get All Four Seasons of Heroes for Just $20 at Amazon
summary: The complete "Heroes" TV series is on sale at Amazon. Get all four seasons for only $20. This deal offers a significant saving of $125.

headline: The Duskbloods, Tides of Annihilation, Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 – Catch Up on IGN's Game Previews This Week ICYMI
summary: IGN released multiple game previews this week. Catch up on coverage for "The Duskbloods" and "Tides of Annihilation." Previews also include "Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2" and other titles.

headline: Exquisite Corpses: Fox Mask Killer Delivers a Blood-Drenched Comic Book Epic
summary: "Exquisite Corpses" is launching a new spinoff. The focus is on the fan-favorite character, the Fox Mask Killer. Expect a blood-drenched and gory comic book epic.

headline: Prince Harry and six others ordered to pay initial £9.5m to Daily Mail publisher
summary: Prince Harry and six co-claimants must pay £9.5m to Daily Mail's publisher. This initial payment follows their loss in a High Court privacy case. They could face an additional £25m in costs.

headline: El Niño warming set to be 'strongest in living memory', warns Met Office
summary: The Met Office warns of an unprecedented El Niño event. It's projected to be the strongest in living memory. This could lead to global temperature rises and a stormier UK autumn in 2027.

headline: Under-fives and pregnant women told to avoid runny eggs when eating out over salmonella risk
summary: Vulnerable groups are advised to avoid runny eggs when dining out. This warning is due to an ongoing salmonella outbreak risk. Affected groups include under-fives, pregnant women, over-65s, and those with underlying conditions.

headline: Steve Rosenberg: Shortage of petrol but not patriotism as Russians feel growing impact of war
summary: Russian citizens are experiencing severe petrol shortages. Drivers face long queues for fuel despite national celebrations. The war's impact is increasingly felt by the population.
